$comment: Shared by exercises and plans. `ordinal` is for sorting and for filtering 'at or below my level'.

items.label: Beginner
items.description: New to structured training, or returning after a long break.
items.guidance: Prioritise movement quality and consistency over load.

items.label: Intermediate
items.description: Six months or more of consistent training, competent in the main lifts.

items.label: Advanced
items.description: Years of consistent training, near their practical ceiling.
items.guidance: Periodised blocks; small gains need specific targeting.
